feeds.title: Rochester Local » Food
feeds.description: Explore Local food guides, Outdoor dining recommendations and The newest food adventures to be had in Rochester city. Rochester Local is a locally-focused resource website for Rochester MN residents and visitors. We're passionate about our community, and strive to connect Rochester MN to relevant resources, local businesses, and can't-miss happenings.

feeds.title: CHOOCHOO-ca-CHEW
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Tiffany, I love food and adventures. I'm passionate about sharing food from home (Taiwan) with the world. There is so much about Taiwanese food - the people, the history and the stories. Choochoo-ca-Chew will give you a little insight on what Taiwan is like through recipes. I'm developing recipes with local farmers market finds you can recreate in your own kitchen!

feeds.description: Check out the Experience Rochester Blog to find upcoming Dining event schedules, family-friendly activities, local restaurants, and trip planning recommendations. Experience Rochester MN is the official online source catering to visitors with news, information and special experiences in the city.

feeds.title: People's Food Co-op Blog
feeds.description: Stay in the loop with the co-op via the People's Food Co-op Blog. Catch every bit from important updates to special promotions, weekly sales, recipes, and more. People's Food Co-op is a community-owned natural foods market with locations in La Crosse and Rochester.

feeds.title: Green Mill Blog
feeds.description: Check out our News & Blog Page Today for local events info. Featuring the latest goings on in your area and with Green Mill Restaurant & Bar. Green Mill was a neighborhood staple & is still the oldest licensed pub in the region. Our menu has fantastic pizza AND delicious pasta, wings, entrees, burgers, sandwiches, appetizers, delicious drinks, and more.
